subject: english
question:
Change the following sentence into the Active form.

A new computer has been bought for the office.

options.text: The office bought a new computer.
Someone has bought a new computer for the office.
A new computer was bought for the office
Someone is buying a new computer for the office.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To change a sentence from passive voice to active voice, identify the subject performing the action (often implied or mentioned in the context).
 
• The given sentence, "A new computer has been bought for the office," is in the passive voice.
 
• The structure of the passive voice is: *Subject (receiver) + has/have been + past participle + by/for + agent.*
